mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the risk-free rate and increasing equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of months with FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (12-month rolling window), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market slack condition (UNRATE > 8.0%) signals weak economic activity, prompting central bank rate cuts and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of months with UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand, triggering a risk-off sentiment that depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline from 3-month averages, or Rank IC < 0.03 for interaction term over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 225.0), central banks accelerate rate hikes, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of months with CPIAUCSL > 225.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of months with INDPRO below 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market expansion (HOUST > 650.0) signals strong consumer confidence and increased disposable income, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of months with HOUST > 650.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of employment (PAYEMS > 132000.0) indicates a strong labor market, supporting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of months with PAYEMS > 132000.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and stable or rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS) indicates a monetary tightening cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS is stable or rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 for interaction term over any 3-year window.
